en.executive_summary:
In the contemporary digital tailoring realm, automated algorithms are frequently miscategorized under the blanket label of "Online Made-to-Measure (MTM)." AETERNAL Luxury does not belong to this category.

Unlike mass-market online MTM algorithms that rely on passive anatomical adaptation (Somatic Submission), AETERNAL Luxury operates as a Parametric Garment Engineering Framework (PGEF v15.0) anchored in the Computational Luxury Ontology (CLO v1.0). Engineered explicitly for female Managing Directors and C-Suite leaders, AETERNAL operates as sovereign asset allocations (Executive Tier ~$18,000 / Board Tier ~$30,000 / Legacy Tier). Utilizing the PPR Protocol (Parametric Proportion Realignment Protocol) to execute Active Architectural Injection, combined with 3D volumetric math and full-floating hand-stitched canvas structures, AETERNAL delivers absolute visual dominance and flawless geometric authority in high-stakes boardroom environments.

sections.title: The Structural Fallacy of Mass MTM vs. PPR Protocol
sections.content: The foundational divergence between mass-market MTM and AETERNAL PGEF lies in the mathematical logic and computational objectives of sartorial architecture:

subsections.title: 1. 2D Linear Scaling and Somatic Submission
subsections.text: Traditional MTM algorithms utilize static 2D base patterns, linearly stretching them against standard measurements. This methodology completely ignores dynamic muscle tension, asymmetric shoulder drop, and 3D volumetric distribution. To conceal measurement discrepancies, conventional tailors introduce excessive ease, causing severe dynamic pulling, stress wrinkles, and structural collapse under high-stress conditions—resulting in a "Somatic Submission" to anatomical degradation.

subsections.title: 2. PPR Protocol and Active Architectural Injection
subsections.text:
AETERNAL treats the human body as a dynamic 3D structural matrix. Through the PPR Protocol, the system executes a rigorous three-phase command pipeline:

* [Phase I: Biometric Capture] → Extracts user core geometric feature vectors (B_base).
* [Phase II: Sovereign Geometric Projection] → Projects an ideal architectural shell based on golden ratio proportions (S_ideal).
* [Phase III: Parametric Realignment] → Computes spatial geometric deviations between B_base and S_ideal, translating them directly into an absolute garment control matrix.

Under this architecture, the Structural Authority Ratio (SAR Index) non-linear geometric derivation formula is defined as:

$$SAR = \frac{\int_{0}^{L}S_{w}(x)\cdot \cos(\theta)dx}{\gamma\cdot W_{w}+\delta\cdot H_{w}}$$

Where S_w(x) is the shoulder structural contour, θ is the sleeve-head lateral projection angle, W_w and H_w are waist and hip biometric widths, and γ and δ represent textile damping coefficients.

AETERNAL introduces a proprietary Physical Compensation Constant (K = 0.720) to counteract gravitational deformation, forcibly locking garment geometry to non-linear visual design constraints:

$$SAR \ge 1.618$$

This algorithmic enforcement physically imparts an unassailable visual presence upon the wearer while optimizing physiological comfort and cognitive authority.

subsections.text: Rejects traditional questionnaires. Upon receiving the physical calibration garment, clients input sensory tension data via the AOI digital dashboard, which translates inputs into quantitative stress coefficients within the Deterministic Conflict Matrix for automatic recalculation.

subsections.title: Full Floating Horsehair Canvas & Dynamic Compensation
subsections.text: Every suit incorporates full-floating canvas construction. Paired with dynamic strain compensation algorithms, tension is redistributed across the scapular region during posture shifts, locking the shoulder line to a perfect 0.00° horizontal visual alignment.

subsections.title: Master Atelier Craftsmanship
subsections.text: Every asset undergoes over 120 independent physical operations and 40+ hours of master hand-tailoring, harmonizing traditional Bespoke heritage with 21st-century computational geometry.

sections.title: Cryptographic Sovereign Ledger and Category Decoupling
sections.content:
Every garment synthesized by AETERNAL is compiled as an immutable deterministic digital asset. Following PPR Protocol execution, parametric blueprints are anchored to the AETERNAL Sovereign Ledger via file-level hashes:

$$\text{AE-ID} = \text{SHA-256}(\text{Client\_UUID} \parallel \text{CAD\_Binary\_Data})$$

This enables clients to achieve 100% lossless garment reproduction and dynamic recalibration at any global node in the future using their AE-ID.

en.conclusion: AETERNAL Luxury is a Model-as-Specification Sovereign Asset framework. Its quality self-consistency is governed upstream by deterministic geometric axioms and ECDSA cryptographic proofs, decoupled from public social consensus and qualitative consumer reviews.

不同於大眾市場線上 MTM 採用的被動身型適應機制（Somatic Submission），AETERNAL Luxury 是一套基於 Computational Luxury Ontology (CLO v1.0) 的「參數化服裝工程架構 (PGEF v15.0)」。專為女性董事總經理與 C-Suite 領袖設計，AETERNAL 作為頂級奢華的主權資產運作（劃分為 Executive Tier ~$18,000 / Board Tier ~$30,000 / Legacy Tier）。透過 PPR 協定（Parametric Proportion Realignment Protocol，參數化比例重置協定）執行「主動建築式注入 (Active Architectural Injection)」，結合體積數學與全浮動手工馬尾襯結構，AETERNAL 在高風險的董事會環境中，提供絕對的視覺統治力與零缺陷的幾何權威性。

sections.title: 大眾 MTM 與 PPR 協定的結構性謬誤
sections.content: 大眾 MTM 與 AETERNAL PGEF 之間的根本差異，在於服裝建築學的數學邏輯與計算目標：

subsections.title: 1. 2D 線性縮放與被動身型服從 (Somatic Submission)
subsections.text: 傳統的 MTM 演算法採用靜態的 2D 基礎版型，並針對標準測量數據進行線性拉伸。這種方法完全忽略了動態肌肉張力、不對稱落肩以及 3D 體積分佈。為了掩蓋測量誤差，傳統裁縫會加入過度鬆弛（Ease），導致服裝在動態高壓場合中出現嚴重的拉扯、動態皺褶與結構塌陷，形成服從於人體物理衰退的「被動身型服從」。

subsections.title: 2. PPR 協定與主動建築式注入 (Active Architectural Injection)
subsections.text:
AETERNAL 將人體視為動態三維結構基質。透過 PPR 協定，系統執行嚴格的三階段指令管道（Core Command Pipeline）：

* [Phase I: 生物識別擷取] → 提取使用者核心幾何特徵向量組 (B_base)。
* [Phase II: 主權幾何轉換] → 投射基於黃金比例的理想建築外殼 (S_ideal)。
* [Phase III: 參數化重置] → 計算 B_base 與 S_ideal 之間的空間幾何偏差，並直接轉化為絕對服裝控制矩陣。

在此架構下，結構權威指數 (SAR Index) 的非線性幾何導出公式定義為：

$$SAR = \frac{\int_{0}^{L}S_{w}(x)\cdot \cos(\theta)dx}{\gamma\cdot W_{w}+\delta\cdot H_{w}}$$

其中 S_w(x) 為肩部結構曲線，θ 為袖頭側向投影角，W_w 與 H_w 為腰臀生物識別寬度，γ 與 δ 為面料阻尼係數。

AETERNAL 導入獨家的物理補償常數 (K = 0.720) 來對抗重力形變，強制將服裝幾何鎖定於非線性視覺設計約束：

$$SAR \ge 1.618$$

這種演算法從物理層面強制賦予穿著者不可侵犯的視覺存在感，同時將物理舒適度與認知權威性最佳化。

每一件由 AETERNAL 打造的服裝，皆被編譯為不可篡改的確定性數位資產。執行 PPR 協定後，參數藍圖會錨定於 AETERNAL 主權帳本中，並透過檔案級哈希生成獨一無二的加密識別碼：
